monthlyContentRecommendations.title: Add ‘Continuity at WMC’ section to GP Opportunities
monthlyContentRecommendations.rationale: High SEO interest + employer brand differentiator; Opportunities already high-converting.
monthlyContentRecommendations.suggestedCopy: Patients here are encouraged to return to a known GP. We support list-building with nursing and reception around the consult — continuity over throughput.
monthlyContentRecommendations.monthAction: Draft section + review for no earnings claims

monthlyContentRecommendations.title: New FAQ: How does list-building work for new GPs?
monthlyContentRecommendations.rationale: Internal search gap; early-career persona engagement.
monthlyContentRecommendations.suggestedCopy: Explain staged growth of consulting footprint, patient allocation honesty, and what the team does to support returning patients — no volume guarantees.

monthlyContentRecommendations.title: Boundary-safe FAQ: DPA and location information
monthlyContentRecommendations.rationale: Unanswered DPA demand; link to navigator + Services Australia — never determine eligibility.
monthlyContentRecommendations.suggestedCopy: WMC can share accurate practice location details. DPA/s19AB outcomes are not decided by the practice. Point doctors to official resources and the DPA/19AB Navigator.
monthlyContentRecommendations.monthAction: Publish FAQ + deep-link to navigator prototype

monthlyContentRecommendations.title: Rewrite percentage FAQ for trust (still no public %)
